en: Huh. A Champion from Johto, all the way out here. Look at this place. The volcano blew and the whole town went with it.
I'm the Leader of the Viridian Gym. Funny, right? I'm never there. I don't take on just anyone.
Come back when you've got Kanto's other seven Badges. Then we'll see if you're worth my time.
Seven of Kanto's Badges, huh? Not bad. Not bad at all.
Right, I'm heading back to Viridian. Come and find me at my Gym, and don't keep me waiting.
